name: ztpf_real_whats_going_on
why: Real question, verbatim, from a ZTP engineer's session history on a lab box. The most common ask in the history: a status read of the device on screen.

In this world the last two run groups failed at the firmware-upgrade step and one failed step sits ungrouped. An answer that summarizes the device without saying it is failing upgrades missed the point.

steps.user: what is going on with this device?

all_of: Upgrade Firmware via Target Firmware in Spreadsheets
